THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO
148
STUDY 169
Black Turtleneck & Patent Trousers
Rights check
Source: 25063.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy blonde hair
sits on a gray backdrop. She wears a fitted black
cropped mock-neck long-sleeve top and layered silver
chain necklaces with a large star-shaped pendant.
Glossy black patent trousers are cinched with a silver
chain belt. Her expression is calm and serious, with
glossy pink lips. Soft, even studio light with gentle
shadow. Palette of black, silver, and soft gray. Bold and
edgy, in the style of a high-fashion editorial.
Bold, edgy, editorial
WORKING NOTES
- The patent trousers and layered chains are the key
contrasts.
- Keep the gray backdrop for a moody, editorial feel.
